newsitem.title: USA: OTR Express cites higher costs for Q1 loss.
newsitem.headline: OTR Express cites higher costs for Q1 loss.

text.p: OTR Express Inc said Tuesday continued higher fuel costs and weak demand for freight services in January and February contributed to a loss in the first quarter ended March 31.

The company posted a loss of $203,000, or $0.11 a share, compared to a loss $221,00, or $0.12, in the same period one year ago. Revenues rose to $13.8 million from $13.0 million in the first quarter of 1996.
OTR Express, a long-haul shipping carrier, said it has continued its fuel surcharge program to share some of its additional costs to its customers.
The company also reported improvement in fuel prices in March, with prices falling to $1.15 a gallon from $1.28.
